subject: general
question: Mrs. Gupta invested a sum of ₹50,000 in fixed deposit for 1 year at the rate of 8% per annum compound interest compounded semi-annually. What amount will she get on maturity of the fixed deposit?
solution:
**Given:**

Total sum = 50,000

Total time = 1 year

Rate = 8% per annum

Compound interest compounded semi annually.

**Concept:**

For 2 year compound interest golden ratio is 2 : 1

**Calculation:**

Rate = 8% per annum

Rate for 6 month = 4%

The golden ratio for 2 year compound interest is 2 : 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/593d2874001fdabcde0aa456ffc085a232cabd387658c76e9f2308f185979cb1.png] 

So, Amount is 50000 + 2000 × 2 + 80 = 54080

∴ He will get ₹54,080 after maturity of fixed deposit.
